Three products we know from the ground up

Each one comes from our own farm or from family in Uttar Pradesh. Specifications and packing are confirmed with every buyer before we quote.

Own farm

Mint oil (Mentha arvensis)

Distilled from mint grown on our family farm in Barabanki, in India's main mint belt. Used for menthol, flavours, fragrance and personal care.

3301 25 90
Origin
Barabanki, Uttar Pradesh

180 kg drum
Testing
GC report from a testing lab, shared before shipment
Family source

Natural jaggery

Cane jaggery made in Uttar Pradesh the traditional way, with no added colour or chemicals. That is why it is deep brown. Very bright yellow jaggery is often lightened with chemicals.

HS code
1701 13 10
Origin
Uttar Pradesh
Season
Fresh stock from the current crushing season
Packing
To the buyer's specification
Family source

Kala Namak rice

The aromatic rice of eastern Uttar Pradesh, from Siddharthnagar, the original GI region of Kala Namak. The husk of the paddy is black. The grain inside is white and fragrant.

HS code
1006 30
Origin
Siddharthnagar, Uttar Pradesh
New crop
December–January
Samples
Current crop, available now

How we work

Three steps, so both sides build trust before volumes grow.

  1. STEP 1

    Sample

    Tell us your specification. We courier a sample for your own testing.

  2. STEP 2

    Trial order

    A small first order, usually by air, to check quality, documents and delivery end to end.

  3. STEP 3

    Regular supply

    Commercial lots by sea on an agreed schedule, to the same specification each time.

Trial and air shipments100% advance by bank transfer (TT)
Sea shipments30% advance, 70% against copy of the bill of lading
IncotermsFOB or CIF, quoted per enquiry
